title: Clinical Coverage Policy — Qualification, Written Order and Setup of PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Qualification, Written Order and Setup — PAP Therapy Equipment

## 1. Qualification of a coverage-billed order

1.1 A coverage-billed PAP Therapy Equipment order qualifies when the qualifying test shows an AHI of at least the class's AHI value, or at least the class's lower AHI value with documented symptoms or comorbidities, plus the class's own requirement: prior CPAP failure where the class requires it, and an ejection fraction above the class's ejection fraction threshold where that threshold is above 0.

1.2 A patient whose order calls for a backup rate needs a class that delivers a backup rate.

1.3 A written order older than the class's written-order validity in months cannot start therapy.

## 2. Setup

2.1 Setup is scheduled the class's setup lead in business days after the order is complete, in one of the class's allowed setup modes, by a respiratory therapist where the class requires respiratory therapist setup.

2.2 **Prior authorization.** When the primary coverage's class requires prior authorization for PAP devices (a value of that coverage class under Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility), a coverage-billed device is set up only once a prior authorization request on this device record is approved and the setup date is within the coverage's prior-authorization validity days of its decision date.

2.3 **Eligibility currency.** A coverage-billed device is set up only when the coverage's last eligibility check is within that coverage class's eligibility re-verification days before the setup date.

2.4 Both setup conditions are read from the system's records — the prior authorization request on this device record, its status and decision date, the class of the primary coverage, and the coverage's last eligibility check date — before the setup is recorded.

## 3. Self-pay devices

3.1 A self-pay device needs only a valid written order and full payment.

## Setup conditions for a coverage-billed device

| Coverage class requires prior authorization | Approved prior authorization on this record, setup date within its validity | Last eligibility check within the re-verification days before setup | Setup |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | may be set up |
| yes | no | any | not set up |
| no | not needed | yes | may be set up |
| any | any | no | not set up |

## Qualification examples (hypothetical results)

- CPAP Fixed-Pressure System (E0601), AHI 18.2, no symptoms documented: qualifies on the AHI alone.
- Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601), AHI 7.0 with documented daytime sleepiness: qualifies on the lower AHI with symptoms.
- Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470), AHI 22.0, no record that CPAP was tried and proved ineffective: does not qualify, because the class requires prior CPAP failure.
- Adaptive Servo-Ventilation System (E0471), ejection fraction at the class threshold: does not qualify, because the fraction must be above it.
